nodes.name: MP equals POW/5, overspends damage HP one-for-one, and regenerates by POW tier
Book study typically takes 2D6 weeks and uses a Hard INT roll unless success is automatic
Personal teaching uses the book rules but typically takes 1D8 days
Entity teaching may require an INT roll and suggests at least 1D6 SAN loss
A newly learned spell requires a Hard POW roll; later casts and NPC casts need no casting roll
A failed pushed casting still works and costs the spell cost multiplied by 1D6 with dire side effects
A significantly disrupted casting fails but still pays SAN and MP costs
Chapter 12 defines spell costs, casting times, effects, variations, and deeper versions
